construction.candidate_loss: A_i = B_i * m_i, m_i = (1 - C) * exp(s * z_i - s^2 / 2), z_i = sqrt(rho) * g_c + sqrt(1 - rho) * e_i (g_c per component, e_i per row, both N(0, 1)); E[m_i] = 1 - C, losses stay nonnegative (scripts/tf_v1_power.py construction)
construction.comparator_loss: B_i: the development D3 WikiText H1w out-of-fold absolute residuals of the registered tree (section 3 / A4), resampled by whole ancestry components; per-item-block components as the A2.3 joint procedure uses them
construction.procedures: A5.4.2 exactly: L = log(A_cand / A_comparator), component influences, conditional and joint (V_comp + V_item - V_both) studentisation, 4,000 draws, linear .025/.975 quantiles, guard A_x / n > 1e-12, at least two components; any invalid draw makes that simulated panel non-excluding (counted, never replaced)
construction.sizes: the registered row sets' actual component counts and component sizes (metadata only), fixed when the eligible rows are listed before fitting

gates.boundary_false_exclusion_at_C_0.05: P(upper bound < 0.05 | true C = 0.05) <= 0.035 for each member and procedure (the A2.3 one-sided null-rejection limit applied at the boundary)
gates.failure: any member failing either gate, or with invalid/undefined simulation, leaves F5.5(b) unresolved; there is no substitution of a .5 ladder rule or any other member
gates.power_at_C_0: P(both procedures' upper bounds < 0.05 | true C = 0) >= 0.80 for each member and each procedure separately (simulated rate itself; exact CP 95% interval reported)
